feature: Bounded hierarchical intent portfolio and runtime decision DAG

implemented.directives: PF2e legality, recovery, Fleeing, Confused and preservation withdrawal remain outside ordinary utility competition
implemented.doctrine: Each actor exposes simultaneous contribution, delivery, risk and resource dimensions
implemented.engagements: Known actor-target relations record current and action-distance reach, counter-threat, visibility, cover, concealment and range penalty
implemented.portfolio: Up to four applicable intents within four abstract score points are grounded through their own active behavior components
implemented.methods: Concrete actions and existing multi-action turn plans are classified as immediate payoff, same-turn setup, next-turn setup, hold, recovery or disengagement
implemented.selection: Grounded methods are merged before the existing priority-layer and bounded-variety chooser; a lower abstract intent can win through a stronger concrete method
implemented.weights: Severe range penalties, useful range closing, same-turn setup, target alignment and belief-safe defensive holds are explicit recorded terms
implemented.trace: The worker emits foundry-creature-ai/planning-trace@1 with shared facts, engagement relations, OR intents, engagement hypotheses, temporal choices, AND methods, primitives and outcomes
implemented.privacy: Doctrine and traces use the prepared belief state; secret check truth is not added to decision input
implemented.diagnosticBound: Each intent displays at most six grounded methods and at most 24 individual rejection nodes
